banner.provenance: The pure flip of the issue-22 four-round shape - no new ink pinned, all three report-022 boxes closed. The issue-22 openers stand at R946 (t22: the military-history triptych - the First Assassins, the Irresistible Force, the Armies of the Renaissance), R947 (s22: the AD&D DMG sneak preview table round) and R948 (k22: the commentary set - What It Is and Where It Is Going, the pole arms taxonomy, the Berg rebuttal, Stalemate at Kassala, the Mapping the Dungeons catalog). The combined TD22-plus-LW13 experiment issue of February 1979, print folio equal to PDF page, is the first issue to ride the four-round shape. The Sullin levels 7-9 and the brawling sequel watches ride to TD 23.
